content: Am7e Zayte
Nabetape issuwa machiya Elsako bada, “Ne aylley, ta azinay hayqis. I Godaa yayiya asi gideysa neeni eraasa. Shin ha77i iya aco aaway ta nayta nam7a baw aylle oothanaw koyees” yaagada iyaw odasu.
Elsi, “Yaatin taani new ay ootho? Ne son aybe de7ey? Ane taw oda” yaagis. Maccasiya, “Taw, ne ayllees guutha xaaron de7iya zaytepe attishin, harabay aybika baawa” yaagasu.
Elsi, “Bada ne shoorota ubbaafe kaysa otota garxa. Garxashe guuthu garxofa.
Hessafe guye, soo gelada, ne bollanne ne nayta bolla kariya gorda. Oto ubban zayte tiga; zaytey kumida otota issi bagga aatha” yaagis.
Maccasiya bada, kariya ba bollanne ba nayta bolla gordasu. Enti iw otota shiishin, iya zaytiya tigethi oykasu.
Oto ubbay kumida wode, maccasiya ba na7aako, “Ane taw hara oto ekada ya” yaagasu. Shin na7ay zaaridi, “Hari issi otoyka deenna” yaagis. Hessafe guye, zaytey goggeysa aggaagis.
Maccasiya simma bada Elsas odasu. I, “Bada zaytiya bayzada, ne acuwa qanxa. Attidaysa neeninne ne nayti go7etidi daanaw danda7eeta” yaagis.
Issi gallas Elsi issi dure maccasiya de7iya Suneema katama bin, maccasiya shoobbada, iya kathi muzasu. He gallasape doomin, I yaara aadhiya wode ubban kathi maanaw I soo gelees.
Iya ba azinaako, “Heko, ubba wode nu matara aadhiya addey Xoossaa asi gideysa taani erayis.
Ane issi guutha kifile pooqiya bolla iyaw keexoos; iya giddon arsi, oyde, xarpheezanne xompe wothoos. I nuuko yida wode ubban yaa gelanaw danda7ees” yaagasu.
Issi gallas Elsi Sunaama katama yidi, ba kifiliya pude keyidi yan shempis.
Ba aylliya Giyaazako, “Bada maccasiw xeega” yaagin, Giyaazi xeegin, iya yada Elsa sinthan eqasu.

Elsi Giyaazako, “Ha maccasiya ha ubbaa nuus oothasu. Nuuni new ay oothino? Nuuni bidi, kawa woyko toora mocona odisanabay aybi de7iyako iyo oycha” yaagis. Maccasiya, “Taani haysan ta asaa giddon de7ayis” yaagasu.
Elsi Giyaaza, “Yaatin, taani iw ay ootho?” yaagidi oychis. Giyaazi, “Iw na7i baawa; I azinay cimis” yaagis.
Elsi, “Maccasiw xeega” yaagis. Giyaazi iyo xeegis; iya yada, pengen eqasu.
Elsi, “Wonto laythi hannoode neeni adde na7a idimmana” yaagis. Maccasiya, “Akay, ta godaw, neeni Xoossaa asi gidiki, taw wordotopa” yaagasu.
Shin maccasiya qanthatasu; Elsi iw odidaysada, kaalliya laythi adde na7a yelasu.
Na7ay diccis; issi gallas katha cakiya asatara de7iya ba aawako bis.
Ba aawako, “Woo! Tana huuphey wodhees; woo! Tana huuphey wodhees” yaagis. Iya aaway issi aylliya, “Tookada aayeko efa” yaagidi kiittis.
Aylley na7aa ekidi, aayeko efis. Seeta gallas gidana gakanaw, na7ay ba aaye ki7on uttis; hessafe guye, na7ay hayqi aggis.
Maccasiya na7aa pude efada, Xoossa addiya arsan zin7isasu. Yaatada iya bolla kare gordada basu.
Ba azina xeegada, “Taani Xoossa addiyako elle bada yaana mela, aylletape issuwanne haretape issuwa taw yedda” yaagasu.
I, “Hachi ageena xeero gallas woyko Sambaata gidenna; nena iyako efey aybee?” yaagis. Iya zaarada, “Aybika baawa” yaagasu.
Iya hare caanada, ba aylliya, “Hariya laagga! Taani new odana gakanaw, lepi oothada laaggofa” yaagasu.
Maccasiya yaape dendada, Qarmeloosa zuman de7iya Xoossa addiyako basu. Elsi maccasiya haahon be7idi, ba aylliya Giyaaza, “Be7a, Sunaaman de7iya maccasiya yawusu.
Iyo mokanaw woxa bada, ‘Neeni saro? Ne azinay saro? Ne na7ay saro?’ yaagada oycha” yaagis. Maccasiya, “Nuuni ubbayka saro” yaagasu.

Maccasiya zumaa bolla de7iya Xoossaa addiyako gakida wode, hokada iya tohuwa oykasu. Giyaazi maccasiw digganaw shiiqis; shin Xoossa addey, “Agga! iya gita meton de7awusu; shin Goday taape hessa genthis. I metuwa taw odibeenna” yaagis.
Maccasiya, “Ta godaw, neeni taw na7a immana mela taani nena oychadina? Taani nena, ‘Tana coo cimmofa yaagabikinaa?’ ” yaagasu.
Elsi Giyaazako, “Ne adussa ma7uwa ne saqiyan sirqa; ta xam7a ekada ellesa. Ogen ooderaka gahetiko, sarothofa; oonika nena sarotiko, zaarada saro goopa. Ta xam7a na7aa som7uwa bolla wotha” yaagis.
Shin na7aa aayiya, “De7o Goday eriya mela, ne shempoy ero! Taani nena yeggada biike” yaagasu. Elsi dendidi, iyo kaallis.
Giyaazi entafe sinthatidi bidi, xam7a na7aa som7uwa bolla wothis. Shin girsi woyko shempoy baawa. Yaatin Giyaazi Elsara gahetanaw simmi yidi, “Na7ay barkibeenna” yaagidi odis.
Elsi soo gelidi, Heko, na7aa ahay iya arsan zin7idaysa be7is.
Ba bollanne na7aa bollanne kariya gordidi, Godaa woossis.
Na7aa aha bolla keyidi, ba doona iya doonan, ba ayfiya iya ayfiyan, ba kusheta iya kushetara gathidi zin7is; na7aa asatethay ho77is.
Elsi dendidi, soo giddon yaa haa simeretis. Nam7antho simmidi, na7aa bolla zin7is; na7ay laapun toho hadhishidaape guye xeellis.
Elsi Giyaaza xeegidi, “Sunaama maccasiw xeega” yaagis. Giyaazi iyo xeegin, iya yida wode, Elsi, “Ne na7aa eka” yaagis.
Maccasiya Elsa tohuwa bolla kundada, sa7an gufannasu; ba na7aa ekada kare keyasu.
Elsi Galgala simmidi yida wode, biittan koshi de7ees. Nabeta cugay iya sinthan uttidi de7ishin, I ba aylliya, “Wogga oto tama bolla wothada, nabetas woxe katha” yaagis.
Entafe issoy bonco maxidi ehanaw wora bidi, ecere leehe daaniyaba demmis. Tookanaw danda7eysa keena daro ecere leehe ekidi yis; I aybeko eronna ancidi, otuwan yeggis.
Asay maana mela woxiya kessidosona; enti woxiya tushi bari be7idi, “Nabiyaw, ha otuwan wodhiyabay de7ees” yaagidi waassidosona. Asay maanaw danda7ibookona.
Elsi, “Ane taw dhiille ekidi yiite” yaagis. He dhiilliya otuwan qolidi, “Asay maanada woxiya tigite” yaagis. Hessafe guye, otuwan iitabay bentibeenna.

Koyro gakida kathaafe uuketida laatamu banga daabbuwa, tiya kathara issife ba ogoruwan yeggidi, Xoossa addiyas ehiya issi addey Ba7aal-Shalishapee yis. Elsi ba aylliya, “Maana mela asaas aatha” yaagis.
Iya aylley, “Taani xeetu asaa sinthe haysa waatada aatho?” yaagidi oychis. Shin Elsi, “Maana mela asaas aatha; Goday ‘Enti midi kallin, tiifey attana’ ” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, aylley enta sinthe aathin, enti midosona; Goday gidaysada tiifey attis.
